snippet.title: Grow It! - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Grow It!, an incremental drug-cooking simulation game developed by Deuce Games. Players will operate a money-making operation to cook drugs, rake in profits, and pay the dealer what he's rightfully owed. Grow It! is coming soon to PC (Steam).
